unlisted_practices: Using the HL7 messaging standard and open-source tools to integrate deep-learning pathology models into the anatomic pathology laboratory information system
Automatic background model selection by tissue type and staining, with on-demand model selection by pathologists
Displaying model predictions as colored heatmaps in QuPath and as slide descriptions in the virtual slide tray

screen.reason: The study demonstrates and describes a proof-of-concept deployment integrating 16 deep learning models into an operational pathology laboratory information system (LIS) via HL7, but does not test or compare specific deployment practices/safeguards against an alternative.
